{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "conductor",
  "displayName": "Conductor",
  "version": "1.7.1",
  "description": "Context-driven development for Claude Code: setup, spec, plan, implement, review, programmes, and decision tracks.",
  "author": {
    "name": "newtonmunene99",
    "email": "newtonmunene99@gmail.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/newtonmunene99/claudekit",
  "repository": "https://github.com/newtonmunene99/claudekit",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "conductor",
    "claude",
    "planning",
    "spec-driven",
    "context-driven"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "ends": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band chip ends",
      "description": "round gives the band's chips and terminal buttons half-disc ends (needs a font with Powerline symbols, which Ghostty bundles); square draws plain chips that work in any font.",
      "options": [
        "round",
        "square"
      ],
      "default": "round"
    }
  }
}
